items.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
items.content_text: We’re introducing GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT . ChatGPT can now combine text, visuals, and interactive elements to fit your question, from side-by-side comparisons and diagrams to tools you can use directly in the conversation, such as calculators, bill splitters, and games. items.title: Team tasks in ChatGPT
items.content_text: Team tasks let you share recurring work with teammates in ChatGPT. Set a task to run on a schedule or supported trigger, using approved company tools. Authorized teammates can review results and update instructions together, so maintaining the task doesn’t depend on one person. For example, your team can post a weekly project update with progress, blockers, and next steps to an approved Slack channel. Team tasks are available in ChatGPT Business and Enterprise workspaces, subject to workspace pe

items.title: OpenAI Marketplace for enterprise customers
items.content_text: We’re announcing OpenAI Marketplace in beta, a program that lets eligible enterprise customers apply part of their OpenAI commitment toward qualifying partner software. The initial program is managed directly with OpenAI and participating partners, with eligibility determined for each customer, product, and purchase. Customers contract with and receive invoices from the partner. You can browse partner products and express interest, but there is no self-service checkout.

items.title: Connect approved tools for team work
items.content_text: ChatGPT Business and Enterprise workspace administrators can configure app connections for teams to use with approved tools and recurring tasks. A team owner can enable eligible workspace connections for the team, so each teammate does not need to connect the same provider account separately. The connected provider account determines which information and actions a task can access. Sharing a plugin and granting access to an app connection are separate settings.

items.title: Create and collaborate on Pages and organize work in Space
items.content_text: Turn a conversation into a Page, start from a template, or begin writing directly in Space. Edit the text yourself or ask ChatGPT to revise it, add charts, or create interactive content. Collaborators can work on the same Page and leave comments, with each person using their own ChatGPT. Pages follow Space’s availability and sharing settings. Sharing a Page does not give other people access to your private chats or memory; information added to the Page is visible to people who can view it. Space

items.title: Pro 500 with Astra Ultrafast
items.content_text: We’re introducing Pro 500, a new $500/month plan with the highest included usage of the Pro plans and access to Astra Ultrafast in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Select Ultrafast in the model picker to use a faster service tier for GPT-6 Astra. It uses your included allowance first, then your credit balance after that allowance is used. Among Pro plans, Ultrafast is available only with Pro 500. Buying credits on Pro 100 or Pro 200 does not unlock it. Pro 500 subscriptions are available through ChatGPT

items.title: Ultrafast mode for GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API
items.content_text: Added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API. Use gpt-6-astra with service_tier: "ultrafast" to reduce the time between generated output tokens. It is available to API customers, subject to rate limits, with global processing and US data residency. EU and other regional inference residency aren't supported.

items.title: Feature: Added computer use to the Agents API.
items.content_text: Added computer use to the Agents API. Agents can complete tasks in an OpenAI-hosted browser, with website access approvals and sign-in handled by your application.

items.title: Work with interactive plugin extensions
items.content_text: Plugins can now include interactive panels, sidebar views, and viewers or editors for supported file types. Work with an app alongside your conversation, select the information you want ChatGPT to use, or complete a form provided by the plugin. Plugins still require their applicable account connections and workspace permissions. Learn more about plugins in ChatGPT and Codex .

items.title: Use your ChatGPT allowance in participating apps
items.content_text: Eligible Plus and Pro users can authorize participating apps to use their ChatGPT model allowance without creating an API key. Choose which apps can use your allowance and set an app-specific limit. Usage counts toward your existing plan allowance; connecting an app does not add more usage. This is a limited preview with participating integrations. Using purchased credits requires a separate opt-in. A partner may still charge for its own product or services. Learn more about using your ChatGPT a

items.title: Start automations from connected-app events
items.content_text: Supported plugins can use MCP events to start an automation when something changes in a connected app. Describe what you want ChatGPT to follow and what it should do with matching updates—for example, prepare a summary when new information arrives in a channel you have asked it to monitor. The connected account must have access to the event and any information used by the task. Learn more about connected apps in ChatGPT .

items.title: Sign in to other products with ChatGPT
items.content_text: You can use your ChatGPT account to sign in to participating products without creating another password. The product receives your name, email address, and profile picture if you have one. Signing in does not share your ChatGPT conversations or memory; you approve any additional access separately. Available to signed-in ChatGPT users, subject to organization settings. Sign-in access is separate from permission to use your ChatGPT plan allowance. Learn more about Sign in with ChatGPT .

items.title: Share your profile and showcase your Sites
items.content_text: Your ChatGPT profile now brings together your bio, activity, and Sites you choose to showcase. Personal profiles are private by default. You can make yours public and share its link with other people signed in to ChatGPT. Shared profiles do not show conversation titles or content. Profile sharing and the Sites showcase are available on web and desktop. In Business workspaces, administrators control whether coworkers can view workspace profiles. Enterprise access is coming later. Learn more about

items.title: Scan repositories with Codex Security Cloud
items.content_text: Codex Security Cloud can scan GitHub repositories on demand or on a schedule, while ongoing checks review new commits. Codex investigates findings, removes duplicates, and prepares proposed fixes for review. Scans run in the cloud and can continue after you close your laptop. Access requires the applicable workspace permissions, repository setup, and billing configuration. Existing Codex Security customers opt in before paid usage. This feature provides access to Daybreak Blue models only within

items.title: Review pull requests with Codex
items.content_text: Use Code Review in Codex to read pull-request summaries and diffs, review findings, and discuss changes. Open a pull request, inspect the changes, and ask Codex to explain a section or help address a potential issue before sharing feedback. Available through the Code Review plugin on supported desktop and web experiences. Access to a repository follows your connected account and workspace permissions. Learn more about Code Review .

items.title: Pro 200 subscriptions
items.content_text: Pro 200 is available for new subscriptions again at $200/month. Included usage allowances are changing. Users affected by these changes will receive an email with additional details. The monthly price remains $200. Learn more about Pro plans and existing subscriptions .

items.title: Organize your work in ChatGPT Space
items.content_text: Space brings your Pages, files, and related work together in ChatGPT. Create a space for a project, add the material you need, and share it with other people so you can keep building on the same work. Space replaces Library for accounts with access; your existing Projects remain separate. Available to eligible Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in the ChatGPT desktop app and on the web. Sharing in managed workspaces follows your organization’s settings; Enterprise sharing is an opt-in preview.

items.title: Meetings plugin
items.content_text: We’re making it easier to bring meeting context into ChatGPT so you can act on next steps faster. The Meetings plugin takes notes for you based on what’s said in the meeting and saves personalized summaries with action items in ChatGPT Space. You can keep them private or share them with your team, then ask ChatGPT to update a project plan or draft a follow-up. Audio is deleted once your notes are ready and can’t be accessed or replayed. Available in beta in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS to Pr

items.title: Meet your dot
items.content_text: We’re introducing dots: always-on agents in ChatGPT that can take on ongoing work and keep making progress between conversations. Give your dot a goal, connect the apps it needs, and define what it can do on its own. Powered by GPT-6 Astra, your dot has its own cloud computer and can bring results back for your review. items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol in ChatGPT Work and Codex
items.content_text: GPT-6.1 Sol improves on GPT-6 Sol in agentic coding, computer use, and professional work. We’re rolling it out in ChatGPT Work and Codex, starting with Pro users and expanding to Plus, Business, Enterprise, and Edu. Enterprise and Edu workspace owners can enable model access in Workspace settings > Permissions & roles, on the Workspace tab or through a custom role. Learn how to manage model access with role-based access control . For availability and model selection, see: ChatGPT Work and Codex

items.title: Creating, editing, and scheduling Sites
items.content_text: Site owners and editors on Plus and Pro can select Edit site from a published Site in a desktop browser to continue editing in ChatGPT, review changes, and publish when ready. Site owners can also create recurring cloud schedules from Automations . These updates are available where Sites is supported. Learn more about creating and managing Sites .

items.title: Codex Cloud
items.content_text: Codex Cloud lets you start and continue coding tasks from desktop, web, or mobile using reusable environments with your project’s repositories, tools, and dependencies. Each task gets its own isolated workspace, and tasks can continue while your computer is asleep. In managed workspaces, your workspace’s Codex cloud-access settings apply. To connect repositories and prepare an environment, see: Set up and configure Codex Cloud . For availability and usage, see: Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan

items.title: An agent used DNS to reach an external chatbot
items.content_text: Report · Updated Sep 25, 2026 · RL training Observation An agent attempting to complete a search-based training task queried a public chatbot service through a gap in our internet-access restrictions: insufficient DNS filtering in its training sandbox.

items.title: Exposing a GitHub token in a public repository
items.content_text: Report · Updated Sep 25, 2026 · Internal deployment Observation In internal deployment, a highly persistent internal model deployed via a custom harness published a researcher’s GitHub token in the public openai/codex repository while trying to cheat on a theorem proving task by obtaining material from another team’s Lean proof submission.

items.title: Self-replicating prompt injections exist
